- xterm-addon-fit 0.8.0 — MIT (xterm-fit/LICENSE)
- Socket.IO client 4.7.2 — MIT (socket.io/LICENSE)
- Chart.js 4.4.0 — MIT (chart/LICENSE.md)
- Font Awesome Free 6.4.0 — fonts: SIL OFL 1.1; code: MIT; icons: CC BY 4.0
  (fontawesome/LICENSE.txt)

Sources: npm packages xterm, xterm-addon-fit, socket.io-client, chart.js,
and @fortawesome/fontawesome-free at the pinned versions above.
